title: AccessKeyIssueRequest
description: media.access-key-issue-request@1 (ADR-031): the body of POST /api/v1/projects/:project_id/access-keys on OpenVibe.Media (capability media.access_key.manage), sent by a first-party service (OpenVibe.Zone, OpenVibe.Services) for the person in on_behalf_of, who must be an admin or owner of the project (Network decides). The answer is 201 media.access-key-issued@1. A zone that is not an active zone of this project environment answers 404 media.access_key.unknown_zone; more than 50 live keys in one environment answer 409 media.access_key.limit.
